lines: Ah, a toast to this wonderful world again today.
Even the laughter that flies through the city…
…is just a fabricated thing we pretend not to see.
I feel like I'm going insane.
A scent so strong it makes my head spin,
…pierces the back of my nose.
I awaken exactly as my instinct dictates.
Whose turn is it today?
What can one do in this world?
What can I do?
So that those pitch‑black eyes of mine
won’t overflow with tears.
I keep wishing for that future, over and over,
devouring it.
In this world full of mistakes,
I want you to smile.
I won’t hurt anyone any more.
I want to become stronger, stronger.
So that I can remain myself.
This wonderful world is safe again today.
Even the bad rumors swirling through the city…
…we turned away, pretending not to know.
That’s not a sane thing at all.
A parade dressed up seriously,
whose marching steps bounce toward a destination,
a lingering taste that never fades clings inside.
The world behind the scenes.
Living purely and rightly,
living without making anyone sad,
living straight without straying,
is that what it means to live without error?
Is living just as we are the true justice?
Is deceiving and surviving a form of justice?
What should my true self be?
Who am I really?
Tell me.
Tell me.
Today as well,
in a world without answers,
I’m wishing.
Though clumsy,
I want to keep laughing forever with you,
because…
Ah, my heart leaps,
shaking my body, I scream.
Now is the time to move.
Ah, I’ll keep devouring my weak self again and again,
until it’s all gone.
In this world full of mistakes,
I want you to smile.
So that no one cries any more,
I want to become stronger, stronger.
So that I can remain myself.
Just to protect you.
I’ll run, run, run.
To surpass the me inside me.
